description: This file defines the DataGroup class within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. The class encapsulates data related to a permission group, including attributes like name, description, allowed permissions, and a list of specific permissions. It provides constructor and factory methods for instantiation, along with getters for accessing properties.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Represents a data group with permissions, including factory and getter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroup instance with name, description, allowed permission, and permissions array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: A static factory method to create a DataGroup instance from an array structure, transforming permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: getAllowed
methods.description: Returns the AllowedPermission object associated with the data group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of DataGroupPermission objects associated with the data group.
